> TRU8 (compression): Day $24.99 · Month $175 · Year $1,900. Year = both products.
> TRU8 public demos: free with credit. Suite: meter, not a seat.

## Chamber (security)
- φ-split keyword shares + AES-256-GCM
- 3-hour black box from first run (hard cut)
- Day $12.50 · Month $87.50 · Year $950
- Half the matching TRU8 tier
- No TRU8 production on this ladder
- SKUs: chamber-day | chamber-month | chamber-year

## TRU8 (compression)
- Public demos free with credit
- T_ZERO / T_DICT / T_TRISUM_HOT
- Day $24.99 and Month $175 = compression only
- Year $1,900 = Chamber + TRU8 for one year
- SKUs: tru8-day | tru8-month | tru8-year
- Legacy aliases: truchamber-* → tru8-*

## Suite (not a seat)
